parsed_json.up: Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules linked to document CHEMBL1123892. Source from molecule_dictionary, compound_records, and compound_structures. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, and compound_records to docs on doc_id. Join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Filter docs where chembl_id equals CHEMBL1123892 and compound_structures where canonical_smiles is not null. Sort rows by chembl_id ascending, then compound_name ascending, then canonical_smiles ascending.
